header: Managing cold indexes in OpenSearch Dashboards
content:
You can manage hot, warm and cold indexes with the existing Dashboards interface in your
OpenSearch Service domain. Dashboards enables you to migrate indexes between warm and cold
storage, and monitor index migration status, without using the CLI or conﬁguration API. For more
information, see Managing indexes in OpenSearch Dashboards.
